csv_project_name: Design Svc for High Rise Roof Replacement - 3 Residence Hall
csv_scope_of_work: UNC Greensboro is seeking letters of interest from qualified professionals for the project entitled, High Rise Roof Replacement. The scope of this project is to evaluate the best solution and implement either replacement, restoration, and/or refurbishment of the existing modified bitumen roofing systems on the Cone, Grogan, and Reynolds Residence Halls. The scope shall address copings, flashings, and caulking issues around the roof perimeters that need to be repaired and/or replaced. Walkway pads will need to be added for safety and access to HVAC equipment that has been added over the years. Given the relatively small footprints of the three buildings, this work has been packaged under one project for efficiency and possible bid day savings. Designers will need to present experience dealing with restricted sites and high-rise roof replacements as all three buildings have very limited access.
